steps.name: Given User should logged into the CRM Support panel
And User is Navigate to Support dashbroad page
When User clicks on Report Module in the sidebar menu
When User clicks Search icon on the top right section of the Report page
When User enters "Agent Scorecards" in the search field in Report page
Then The Summard card should display the relevant "Agent Scorecards" summary card
